Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a mouse neuroblastoma cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on Neuro-2a cells, a mouse neuroblastoma line derived from a spontaneous A/Jax mouse tumor and used as a neuronal cancer model with neuroblast-like and neurite-forming differentiation potential.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from mouse neuroblastoma cultures: nuclei are isolated in bulk, transposed with Tn5 to label accessible regulatory DNA, and amplified libraries profile chromatin accessibility across the cell population.
